extracted.name: Avocado Ranch Salad Dressing
extracted.description: This recipe goes very well as a vegetable dipping sauce!
instruction_lines: Mash avocado in a bowl, then stir in mayonnaise, sour cream, buttermilk, and vinegar. Sprinkle with salt, parsley, dill, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir until well blended, chill until ready to serve.
